decisions.reason: This low-cost burner component supports the core gas radiant heater range, so keeping the option open costs little while demand becomes clearer.

The electric infrared panel line is a flagship of the firm's electrification direction and is only two years old, so its uncertain upside is still worth preserving, even though Product D's withdrawal shows electric lines are being reviewed.

Product D's withdrawal suggests the electric infrared portfolio is being consolidated, but the halogen heater has its own page and costs little to keep, so the evidence does not yet justify abandoning it.
The hydrogen-capable dark infrared series is a strategic flagship with documented real-world operation and a valuable growth option toward low-carbon heating, so it clearly stays.
